text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
"—The pinnacle of American GⅠ racing, the 
Breeders' Cup. Contenders now step up to 
challenge this formidable stage."

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
"The program follows the girls as they set 
their sights on the main event: the 
Breeders' Cup this autumn—"

At the request of the URA, a documentary 
program about "DREAMS" was produced, and 
it aired tonight.

Every entrant now boasts an impressive 
track record. Wanting to hype up the race, 
<chrname> seems to be the center of attention among 
them.
choice_data_list:
It's true that everyone has extremely high 
expectations for her.
It's good to get hyped up

I'm not really used to having a camera 
crew follow me around too, though

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I feel like 
Chairwoman Akikawa said something like 
that last summer, too...

With her victory, everyone surely 
anticipated the beginning of a brand-new 
page in history.

She is now a central pillar of "DREAMS." 
And I feel the exact same way.

I hope you will dedicate yourself to being 
the driving force of this team, advancing 
not just to "admire" others, but to 
surpass your "goals."

If her hard work continued to build public 
anticipation, her circle of supporters 
would only keep expanding.

Whether indirect or direct, it will surely 
become a tailwind propelling us toward 
"DREAMS."

Entrusted with the "dream" of carrying her 
and everyone's hopes to victory, they take 
on the world. That is what it means to be 
a "DREAMS" Umamusume.

—Watching the broadcast made them realize 
anew just how many dreams they were 
carrying on their shoulders.

A little over 8 months left until the BC. 
Let's stay focused and brace ourselves.

It felt a little embarrassing that there 
were so many scenes featuring myself as 
their Trainer, but—

Having a film crew glued to her for hours 
on end and burdening her outside of 
training would be putting the cart before 
the horse.

Besides, she took pride in knowing that 
she understood better than anyone just how 
amazing she and her friends were.

And so, I ended up rambling on quite a 
bit. ...Though a large chunk of it was cut 
out.

Well, there will be plenty of 
opportunities to speak of her brilliance, 
especially after winning the BC.

When that time comes, let's look back on 
that glorious victory and talk our hearts 
out.
